title: Tracing snowlines and C/O ratio in a planet-hosting disk. ALMA molecular line observations towards the HD 169142 disk
question: What are the elemental make-up (specifically the C/O ratio) of the gas and the locations of the CO and H2O snowlines in the planet-hosting HD 169142 disk in relation to its forming planets?

data.angular_resolution: ~0.03" to ~1.0" across projects (synthesized beams from 0.19"x0.14" to 1.07"x0.51")
data.sensitivity: 0.23 to 130.7 mJy beam^-1 per channel (depending on line and channel width)

what.value: Molecular spectroscopic data (frequencies, upper state energies, Einstein A coefficients, degeneracies)

evidence.quote: All of the molecular data are taken from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: 2005JMoSt.742..215M).

evidence.quote: For comparison, we also include the 0.9 mm continuum image and map from (cite: Law2023).

evidence.quote: The dust temperature in the fiducial model of this disk from (cite: 2018A&A...614A.106C) only reaches the freeze-out temperature of CO ($\approx$20 K) in the midplane of the very outer disk at $\approx$150 au
This is also consistent with the model from (cite: 2018A&A...614A.106C) which places the midplane snowline at $\approx$20 au, which is at the edge of the inner dust ring (shown in Figure E1).

recipe.goal: Self-calibration, iterative continuum subtraction, and line imaging
recipe.method: Phase-only self-calibration on continuum after flagging lines; iterative line identification in continuum windows followed by uvcontsub (fit order 1); imaging with tCLEAN using Keplerian masks (<2 km/s resolution) or hand-drawn elliptical masks, applying uv-tapers and imsmooth where needed.
key_parameters: uvcontsub fit order = 1; Briggs robust = 0.5 or 2.0; 0.4" uv-taper for 2016.1.00344.S lines (except HC3N); 0.25" uv-taper and 0.2" imsmooth kernel for CS J=7-6

recipe.method: Matched filtering and spectral stacking using GoFish

recipe.goal: Generate integrated intensity maps, radial profiles, and disk-integrated fluxes
recipe.method: Generated moment 0 maps using the same Keplerian or elliptical masks as imaging with no flux clipping; extracted azimuthally-averaged radial profiles and measured disk-integrated fluxes.
key_parameters: No flux clipping; 10% absolute flux calibration uncertainty adopted for flux errors

recipe.goal: Compute disk-averaged and radial column densities and abundance ratios
recipe.method: Calculated disk-averaged column densities from integrated fluxes and radial column density profiles from azimuthally-averaged emission profiles using standard optically thin LTE methods; convolved SO and CH3OH images with imsmooth to match C34S and H2CO resolution for radial ratios.
key_parameters: Circular emitting area of 2" for disk-averaged column densities (0.3" for CH3OH and SO); T_ex = 30 K and 60 K for cooler gas species, 100 K for SO and CH3OH; fixed T_ex = 60 K for radial column densities
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE), optically thin emission, and ISM isotope ratios (32S/34S = 22, 12C/13C = 69)
